_comment: Dashboard 3: Per-Team/Project Comparison (within a single project). CONFIRMED against a live RP 5.15.x instance: 'componentHealthCheck' requires widgetOptions.attributeKeys (an ARRAY, not singular 'attributeKey'), widgetOptions.minPassingRate (string percentage, e.g. '80'), and widgetOptions.excludeSkipped (string 'true'/'false') -- RP rejects creation with 'No keys were specified' / 'Minimum passing rate option was not specified' / 'Exclude skipped tests option was not specified' otherwise. This widget groups results by the CI-supplied launch attribute named here (default: 'service') -- see dashboard-kit/ci-examples/ATTRIBUTES.md for the tagging convention (team:/layer:/service:). Swap to 'layer' or 'team' if a project prefers grouping by test layer or by sub-team instead of service.

widgets.name: Recent Launches by Attribute
widgets.description: Most recent launches with their team/layer/service attributes visible for quick comparison.

widgets.name: Component Health by Service
widgets.description: Pass/fail breakdown grouped by the 'service' launch attribute, for comparing sub-teams/components within this project.
